paite: Pasal khat in zi aneih a, amah a siang lou banghiam khat amuh ziak a, amitmuh a lungtunna angah keileh hichi ahi ding a, kimakna lai agelhsak dia, ape dia, a-inn a pan apawtsak ding hi.
heading: Kimakna Leh Kiten Nawnna

paite: A-inn a pan apawt nung in midang ava nei thei ding hi.
Apasal nanungpen in azakdah a, kimakna lai agelhsak a, apiak a, a-inn a pan apawtsak hiam, apasal nanungzaw, zi a neipa si hiam ahihleh;
apasal masa, amah paisakpa'n ahih nitsa ahi a, anei nawn thei kei ding. TOUPA mitmuh in hiai thilkihhuai ahi. TOUPA'N luah dia ahon piak gam ah khelhna na lutsak ding uh ahi kei.
Pasal zi nei tung sepaih in akuan ding ahi kei a, bang nna sem dia phut ding leng ahi kei. A-inn ah kum khat zalen in a-om dia, azi lungnuamtak in a-omsak ding hi.
heading: Dan Tuamtuam

paite: Buh gawizanna hiam, atunglam suang hiam kichiamna ding in kuamah a pan na lentang ding uh ahi kei; mi hinna lettangsak na hi ngal ua.
Kuapeuh, Israel suan a-unaute lak a mi gu a, sal a zat hiam, zuak hiam theihkhiak ahihleh huai gutapa hihlup ding ahi. Huchibang na lak ua kipan thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uh ahi.
Phak hipi tungtang thu ah hoihtak a ettel a, siampu, Levite sinsakdan bang zel a hih ding in pilvang un. Amau thu ka piak bang in pilvangtak in na hih ding uh ahi.
Aigupta gam a pan na hong pawtna lampi a TOUPA na Pathian un Miriam tung a ahihdan theigige un.
Bangpeuh na invengte uh na leitawi sakleh akhamna la ding in a-inn ah na lut ding ahi kei.
Inn pua ah na dingh dia, leitawisakmi in tua khamna inpua ah ahon tawikhe ding ahi.
Mizawng ahihleh akhamna kem in na giahpih ding ahi kei.

Bang teng hileh ni ahong tum chiang in akichiamna thil akiang ah pekik in. Huchi in apuantual silh in a-ihmu thei dia, nang hon phat thei ding hi. Huai khamna thil pen na Pathian ma ah nang a ding in diktatna ahi ding hi.
Na migoih, mizawng leh tasam na unau hiam, na gam ua na tenna ua om gamdangmi hiam leng hitaleh na simmoh ding uh ahi kei.
Asep ni in aloh na pe ding uh; ni in atumkhum ding ahi kei. Mizawng ahi a, huai ah alungtang akoih hi. Huchi lou in zaw na tungtang uah TOUPA asam dia, nou a ding in khelhna ahi ding hi.
Tate ziak in pate hihlup ding ahi kei a, pate ziak in tapate leng hihlup ding ahi sam kei. Michih amah khelhna ziak a hihlup ding ahi.
Gamdang mite leh pa neiloute dikloutak a na gensak ding ahi kei. Meithai puan leng khamna ding in na laksak ding ahi kei.

Nou leng Aigupta gam ah sikha na hi ngeita ua, TOUPA na Pathian un huai a pan a hon tat na hi uh, chih na theihgige ding uh ahi. Huchi in TOUPA na Pathian un na khut ngakna chiteng uah hon vualzawl ding hi.

Na lou ua buh na lak un, buhphal na khop maih uleh na lak nawn ding uh ahi kei. Gamdang mite, pa neiloute, meithaite a ding ahi. Huchi in TOUPA na Pathian un na khut koihna tengteng uh avualzawl ding hi.
Na olive sing uh na sat chiang un ahiangte na sat ding uh ahi kei. Gamdang mite, pa neiloute leh meithaite a ding ahi.
Na grephuan ua na loh chiang un asang na zong ding uh ahi kei. Gamdang mite, pa neiloute leh meithaite a ding ahi.
Aigupta gam ah sikha na hita uh, chih na theigige ding uh ahi. Huaiziak in ahi, hiai thilhih dia thu ka hon piak.
